{{- $data := get .agents .name -}}
# Generated by chezmoi from .chezmoitemplates/agent.pod. Edit it there.

[Unit]
Description=Agent environment {{ .name }}: pod and VPN
# Keep retrying instead of giving up after systemd's default start limit.
StartLimitIntervalSec=0

[Pod]
PodName=agent-{{ .name }}
Network=pasta:--ipv4-only
UserNS=keep-id:uid=1000,gid=1000
# Keep the pod up while the agent container restarts
ExitPolicy=continue

[Service]
# Bring up wg0 once the pod's network namespace exists. A throwaway container
# joins the pod as root with NET_ADMIN and nothing else, and gets the private
# key as a podman secret (create it with agent-wg-key {{ .name }}). Nothing that
# keeps running has either. The agent container starts after this succeeds.
ExecStartPost=/usr/bin/podman run --rm --pod=agent-{{ .name }} \
    --user=0 --cap-drop=all --cap-add=NET_ADMIN \
    --secret=agent-{{ .name }}-wg-key,target=wg-private-key \
    --env=WG_ADDRESS={{ $data.address }} \
    --env=WG_ADDRESS_IPV6={{ $data.address_ipv6 }} \
    --env=WG_PEER_PUBLIC_KEY={{ .agents.wg_public_key }} \
    --env=WG_PEER_ENDPOINT={{ .agents.wg_endpoint }} \
    --env=WG_ALLOWED_IPS=192.168.3.0/24,::/0 \
    --env=WG_MTU=1420 \
    quay.io/davidagardh/agent-box:latest agent-wg-up
Restart=on-failure
RestartSec=30
# The first start pulls a multi-gigabyte image.
TimeoutStartSec=900
